title: peucedanum porandicum
intro: Peucedanum porandicum, commonly known as  Himalayan Carrot, is a plant species that belongs to the Apiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as limonene, pinane, and sesquiterpene, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory effects. Additionally, Himalayan Carrot has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and diaphoretic properties.
